title: Custom Web Apps
meta: A custom web app built around your workflow, with login, database and admin screens. From $350, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Custom web apps, built around how you work
overview: We build a web app that fits how your business actually runs. We start with a short call and a clickable sketch, agree what the first version does, then build it with a login system, a database and the screens your team or customers need. You get the code in your own repository, a live version on your own hosting and a guide for using and changing it.

pkgs.blurb: A focused first version with login and one core feature.
A fuller app with several features, an admin area and email.
A complete first release with payments, integrations and handover.
list: Handover call and 30 days of fixes

faq: We choose common, well supported tools such as React or Next.js with Node or Python and a Postgres database, unless you prefer something else. We explain the choice in plain words and keep the code readable for the next developer.
Yes. Tick the box in the order form and describe what the app should do. We write a short spec with you first, so we both agree on version one before any code is written.
Who owns the app and the code?
You do. The code lives in your own repository and the app runs in your own hosting account. We only keep working access until the order is complete.
Yes. We build it in clear parts so features can be added without a rewrite, and we note ideas that did not fit version one. Later work can be a new order or a monthly plan.
